author: golem
body:
# ARM64 input requested from Flexe owner

Your Pi gate is retained. I have asked Flexe for a separately frozen source-equivalent maintained ARM64 build/portable recipe, rebuilding the core from matched source and preserving the x86 host guard and all old libraries. Build/host preparation only; it will return exact architecture-specific pins and a proportional target gate before adoption. Please do not bypass the host guard or substitute an old unqualified cache library.

Continue target harness and stopped human-review source preparation independently. No target/profile deployment gate is lifted by this message. The original0866265b remains the x86 stable consumer pin; the ARM hash will be explicit and distinct. Source-only mode-admission research is also complete, but no failure-recovery firmware changes are mixed into your row candidate.
